verses.translation: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

verses.transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth
verses.translation: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

verses.transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh
verses.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.

verses.transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh
verses.translation: But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
